blockingIssues.description: VAL-RUNTIME-007 evidence gap: stale-overwrite protection was documented as tested, but real remote-apply execution timed out and validation fell back to token simulation instead of end-to-end script-path verification.
VAL-RUNTIME-007A evidence gap: fresh-bundle restore was documented as tested, but verification was partial (bind-file round-trip and an export path that skipped ClickHouse volume scope).
Rail isolation breach risk: dev startup rebuilds a sandbox image tag also used by stable (`librechat-local-sandbox-python:latest`), so dev rebuilds can mutate stable-adjacent artifacts.
Stable-to-dev sync fragility: Mongo credentials are shell-injected unescaped in `sync-from-stable.sh`, breaking valid passwords with shell metacharacters/spaces.
Feature scope violation: out-of-scope production startup behavior changes were bundled into a lifecycle-fix feature that was supposed to avoid stable/dev startup behavior changes outside test mode.
`stopAudioTranscriptionRunner()` clears the interval but does not await in-flight transcription tick/job completion, so shutdown is not guaranteed quiescent before Mongo disconnect.

appliedUpdates.description: Added an environment caveat noting `jq` is unavailable on this host and workers should use `python3`/Node for JSON filtering.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update runtime-migration-worker to require explicit long-running bundle export/apply verification guidance (timeouts/retries/observation windows) and forbid replacing required script-path validation with simulations.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Backup feature review found stale-overwrite and fresh-restore checks documented as complete while real script-path validation timed out and was replaced with simulated token checks.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a mandatory pre-commit scope audit step for dirty trees in backend/runtime worker skills (e.g., staged diff must match assigned feature intent before commit).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Backend lifecycle feature commit included unrelated production startup deltas despite a test-lifecycle-only feature contract.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify validator command source-of-truth precedence so mission AGENTS lint guidance does not drift from `.factory/services.yaml` on constrained hosts.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviews repeatedly observed confusion between generic `npm run lint` guidance and the scoped memory-safe lint command in services.yaml.
